family_reports.body: Family court is the most corrupt thing that I have witnessed. I have watched judges, attorneys, parenting coordinator, GAL, and mediators colluded to extort fathers financially. I have witnessed multiple times of going off the record where the actors discuss their upcoming cases with each other. They make it near impossible to have a court reporter and charge you exorbitant amounts for the transcript. We believe the transcript was altered but how can you prove it. The fact that they fight to keep cameras out of the courtrooms should prove their motives.

The court system has allowed lies told by one side without evidence to be the sole decision in allowing one of my children to be taken. It has caused significant damage to my relationship with my child and the relationship with the child’s siblings.

This system has torn my family apart, stripped me of my role as a mother, and forced me into a relentless fight against abusive exes, distortion, imbalance, and Court decisions that have harmed both me and my child.
